I am very new to shiny. This may be very basic task, but i couldn't able to it. I jus want to read a table, here is my code

server.R
shinyServer(function(input, output) {
data1 <- renderTable({
   
  
   inFile <- input$file1

    if (is.null(inFile))
      return(NULL)
   
   dat<-read.table(inFile$datapath, header=TRUE, sep="\t")
dat<-as.data.frame(dat)
dat1<-melt(dat)
  })



output$StrPlot <- renderPlot({
p<-ggplot(data=data1, aes(x=geno, y=value, fill=variable))+geom_bar(stat="identity", width=1)

print(p)

  })
  })

ui.R
 sidebarPanel(
    fileInput('file1', 'Choose CSV File',
              accept=c('text/csv', 'text/comma-separated-values,text/plain', '.csv')))
